items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated 20.11.2026 (Friday), presumed date of posting (Absenden). Per the letter's own rule (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, as amended): 'ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben'. Counting the day after sending as day 1: 21.11 (Sat)=day1, 22.11 (Sun)=day2, 23.11 (Mon)=day3, 24.11 (Tue)=day4 -> Bekanntgabe (deemed notice) = 24.11.2026, a working day, so no further shift needed. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs under § 26 SGB X i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of notice (24.11.2026) is not counted, period starts 25.11.2026 and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NRW (Heiligabend is not a legal holiday), so the deadline is not shifted.
